test_get_edit_counts: test the alignment module function get_edit_counts to count insertions, deletions, and substitutions between aligned sequences
test_get_edits: test the alignment module function get_edits to extract edit tuples between a query sequence and its parent
test_apply_edits: test the alignment module function apply_edits to apply edit operations to a parent sequence
test_load_msa_from_fasta: test the alignment module function load_msa_from_fasta to parse a FASTA file into an MSA with parent and homologs
test_match_state_selector: test the MatchStateSelector class to select match state positions from aligned or unaligned sequences
